messages:
jamal: Heads-up: PR 8927 (large runtime change) is ready for merge but the CI backlog is crazy. Merge window opens in ~2h and deploy freeze starts at 18:00 UTC. Do we hold? Need a rebase slot? @alex @mira
alex: Looking now. Quick question: does this need a rebaseline of kernels? If yes, prefer to wait for the nightly.
mira: If it touches kernel selection heuristics we should be cautious. What's the risk of landing during freeze?
jamal: It touches kernel selection heuristics and adds a flag for continuous batching. Unit tests pass locally. Integration tests stuck in queue. PR: https://github.com/redwood/pr/8927
ci-bot: CI queue update: 12 runners busy, estimated queue delay ~35m. Failing jobs: 2 flaky infra flakes on macOS nodes.
mira: If queue is 35m and window is 2h, we can probably make it if we re-run now and get green. But with deploy freeze at 18:00 UTC, I'd rather land before freeze starts if it's just one rebase.
luis: TL;DR: If we can't get green in 45m, take the rebase window tomorrow morning. Also we shouldn't trigger a canary during freeze.
jamal: Can we get a rebase slot? /rebase-request for tomorrow 09:00 UTC? @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: Ack. Rebase window tomorrow 09:00 UTC reserved if requested. For today we prefer no large kernel changes during freeze.
jamal: Okay, let's try a rerun. If CI still stuck, I'll move to rebase slot. @alex can you give final approval if green?
alex: Will do. Ping me with green CI and I'll approve. Also add a brief note in the release tracker about kernel flag changes (link: https://redwood.tracker/releases/54).
buildbot: Triggered: re-run for PR 8927 by jamal. Jobs started: unit-tests, int-tests, perf-smoke.
jamal: Perf-smoke tends to be the long pole. If that times out, we can skip perf-smoke for today and schedule perf runs separately? Thoughts?
mira: We should not skip perf-smoke for kernel changes. Instead, create a short perf-smoke variant (smoke-fast) excluding longest cases.
jamal: Good idea. I'll open a short smoke alias and re-run. Command:
```: ci run --profile smoke-fast PR8927
```
ci-bot: smoke-fast profile queued. Estimated completion 20m.
luis: :thumbsup: good plan. If that passes, alex can approve and we merge before freeze. If not, use tomorrow's rebase window.
jamal: Update: smoke-fast green. Full int-tests still running but look good so far. Alex?
alex: Approving now. Please note in changelog: experimental_batching_flag renamed to 'continuous_batch'.
jamal: Merged. Thanks all. I'll follow up with a post-merge rollout note and a perf job schedule.
buildbot: Deploybot: Merge completed for PR 8927 to main. Canary disabled due to nightly freeze policy.
jamal: Closing thread. Filing follow-up ticket: PERF-278 for extended perf runs.
